versions.subject: New Rule - Linux - Auditd - Clipboard Collection of Image Data with Xclip Tool
versions.detection:
xclip:
    type: EXECVE
    a0: xclip
    a1:
      - '-selection'
      - '-sel'
    a2: 
      - clipboard
      - clip
    a3: '-t'
    a4: 'image/png'
    a5: '-o'
condition: xclip
versions.spl: type="EXECVE" a0="xclip" a1 IN ("-selection", "-sel") a2 IN ("clipboard", "clip") a3="-t" a4="image/png" a5="-o"
